scientific_integrity: The universal finite matrix inequality has explicit exact rational decomposition certificates and an explicit integer equality witness. Numerical optimization is not a proof and is unnecessary for certificate checking.
scientific_limitations: Sharp constant only for real four-by-four matrices. The connection to the Grothendieck–Hölder endpoint uses an existing compression theorem; neither higher dimensions nor complex matrices are resolved. Unindexed equivalent older literature remains possible.
title: Exact real four-by-four projective–injective tensor norm ratio
